summary: Operator's pages re-read: 30-amp full hookups, showers, municipal water, dump station, camp store, CampLife/phone booking and the cancellation policy all match the entry's 2026-10-14 values; the site posts no rates ('For Reservations and Current Rates call 304-456-3101'). Nothing new to write.
flags: Price gate (private, not stayed at by the family): CampLife's 2026-10-14 quote is $50 a night for every RV site type plus a flat $6 reservation fee per stay (kept even on a cancellation: 'full refund minus reservation fee'), so one night costs $56 before tax, over US$50. No gateway within 40 km (nearest Shenandoah NP 102 km, New River Gorge NP 121 km).

Waterfront re-audit lead: the operator says 'Our beautiful sites offer both waterside and off-water options', 'we have everything from full hook-up sites to primitive waterfront sites' and that the river 'runs the length of the campground'; the entry is 'riverview'. Waterfront not changed.
Equine-friendly ('Campground and Horse Hotel', horse stalls and equine sites) but a general campground with RV and tent sites, so it passes the horse-camp rule.
